inlines.v: WAFER, noun 1. A thin cake or leaf; as a wafer of bread given by the Romanists in the Eucharist. 2. A thin leaf of paste, or a composition of flour, the white of eggs, isinglass and yeast, spread over with gumwater and dried; used in sealing letters. WAFER, verb transitive To seal or close with a wafer
